items.q: And he was booked with -- this was with the Basie Band. And I was with -- oh, we had Joe Williams... And Stan Getz, Zoot Sims.

ctx.x: And he was booked with -- this was with the Basie Band. And I was with -- oh, we had Joe Williams,

Sarah, had four singers on there, very good singers on there. Had Al Hibbler, Billy Eckstine and Sarah. And Stan Getz, Zoot Sims. It was a very good package, you know? A very sharp package. (Unintelligible) Phineas Newborn.
You were with the Basie band.
